newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian shares trade mixed this week, volumes up.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian shares trade mixed this week, volumes up.

text.p: Three corporate issues traded on the Bulgarian stock market this week as two fell from last Friday's levels due to low investors' interest and one rose, brokers said.
Razvitie Investment Fund third issue was the net loser of the week, falling 2.86 percent to 34 levs.
Varna Grand Hotel led net gainers, rising 2.41 percent to an average of 87 levs, still below par of 100.
Total turnover rose to 93 390 levs ($4,100) from 28,099 levs ($130) the week before and traded volume rose 243 percent to 1,170 shares from 341.
Total weekly repo turnover fell to 2.707 million levs from 5.717 million levs.
The 13-share Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index (RABSI) closed at 41.14 points, up 0.53 from last Friday, due to the rise of Varna Grand Hotel by four levs to 87.
* RABSI calculated on daily basis since February 1, 1994
